reviews.review_text: Lotus Ceylon made our 10-day tour utterly magical. The chauffeur-guide was exceptionally knowledgeable and every hotel exceeded our expectations.
Very professional service, punctual luxury transport, and child-friendly itinerary. We loved the tea plantation and elephant gathering!
